text:
Priya Rao: Hey team — quick design review request for the billing/usage table. I sketched two density modes: compact org-level (dense, aggregated rows) and expanded project-level (one row per project + inline token breakdown). Thinking about readability vs scan-speed. Can we discuss: (1) default for new orgs, (2) how invoices link out, (3) aria labels + keyboard nav for the density toggle? :eyes: Jin Park: Nice. For product goals: default should surface cost at org-level for finance teams, but allow engineers to flip to project view quickly. Suggest default = org-compact. Marco Diaz: UX notes — compact mode reduces row height, shows sparkline + total tokens + last invoice date. Expanded shows per-project small bar + token % breakdown. Concern: compact loses per-project visibility which is common ask. Sam Whitaker: Implementation notes — compact is easy; expanded requires nested rows (accordion) or expanding modal. Nested rows impact keyboard focus and virtualized list complexity. Prefer accordion rows with aria-expanded state. Elena Soto: From support: customers keep asking for a prominent "Download CSV/invoice" CTA next to each invoice row. If we hide it in compact mode they're confused. Suggest always-visible small icon CTA. :file_folder: Priya Rao: Good point. Can we keep a minimal icon CTA in compact (download icon only) and full label in expanded? Copy idea: icon tooltip = "Download invoice (CSV)" Marco Diaz: Accessibility nits — color contrast on sparkline tooltips is low on the dark theme. Also the density toggle label currently says "Compact / Expanded" which isn't descriptive for screen readers. Recommend `aria-label="Toggle invoice density: compact or expanded view"`. Sam Whitaker: Agree on aria-label. Also need focus ring on the toggle and clear keyboard shortcuts (e.g., press "d" while focused on table to toggle density). We can wire a small hotspot and announce via live region on change. Priya Rao: Quick copy tweak for the token breakdown popover: change "Token split" -> "Token usage by project". More explicit. Marco Diaz: UX mock update uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/billing-density — shows download icon placement and live region text. Please review. :sparkles: a11y-bot: Automated check results: contrast failures on sparkline tooltip (WCAG AA fail), missing aria-live on density toggle, and keyboard focus order flagged for nested rows. See summary: https://a11y/reports/1847621111 Sam Whitaker: Plan: I'll prototype accordion rows with `aria-expanded` + `role="row"` semantics and keep download icon as a separate focusable button. Add `aria-live="polite"` region for announcing toggle changes. Priya Rao: Example snippet for the toggle copy we can use in dev (Marco — can you confirm?): ```html
Density set to compact view
``` Marco Diaz: That works. I'd change visible label to just an icon + tooltip; keep the aria-label as above. Elena Soto: For invoices download CTA, use this microcopy: `Download invoice` (visible in expanded) and tooltip `Download invoice (CSV)` for icon in compact. Keeps support docs consistent. Jin Park: Decision proposal: default = org-compact view; small download icon always visible; expanded accordions for project details; accessibility checklist before merge (contrast fix, aria-live, keyboard flow). Approve? Priya Rao: Approve from PM. Marco, Sam — can you run with mocks + prototype? Add a short note in the release checklist for support docs and analytics event when users toggle density (metric: density_toggle_click). Marco Diaz: Yep, will update Figma and add notes. Sam Whitaker: I'll post a brief RFC in eng-platform with implementation details and a small demo by EOD Wed. Elena Soto: I'll update the support KB and keep QA loop open for any odd customer feedback. Priya Rao: Awesome — thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Marco to update mocks (due Tue), Sam to prototype (due Wed), Jin to add analytics event + release checklist. Elena Soto: One last accessibility nit — ensure SVG icons have `role="img"` + `aria-hidden` when decorative. Priya Rao: Good call. Closing thread — will reopen if blockers. :thumbsup:
